name: Play the replay and watch the anchor drag
description: Validates that Play advances the replay clock into the anchor drag and that Pause holds the clock still.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state ready
Assert the anchor status (data-testid replay-anchor-status) reads "Drag starts at 10:26"
Click the button labelled "Play replay" (data-testid replay-play)
Assert the replay clock shows a time later than 10:26 UTC and the anchor status reads "Anchor dragging on the seabed"
Click the button labelled "Pause replay" and note the time shown on the replay clock
Assert the replay clock still shows the noted time and the button is labelled "Play replay" again
